purpose: Post-hoc robustness analysis for the already selected ACRF-v3.5 paper method. This analysis tests sensitivity only; it must not be used to select replacement hyperparameters or modify the discovery method.

scale_factorial.description: Full 3^4 factorial over all four physical distance scales with HDBSCAN fixed at the selected 8/4 setting.

hdbscan_factorial.description: Full 3x3 factorial over min_cluster_size and min_samples at the selected physical scales.

joint_extreme_interactions.description: All 2^4 low/high physical-scale corners crossed with four low/high HDBSCAN corners, to stress scale-HDBSCAN interactions without outcome-guided search.

evaluation.data: Same quality-controlled GMN April 2022-2026 panel and 2025-2026 seed years used by ACRF-v3.5.
evaluation.target_access: For every cell, candidate generation and ranking are completed without target membership. Only afterward, the canonical OrbitTrace timestamp table is opened to identify the ranked family with the highest 2025-2026 seed F1; ties are resolved by greater seed overlap and then lower target-free rank.
evaluation.membership: If the tracked family ranks within the fixed top-100 materialization budget, apply the unchanged ACRF-v3.5 leave-one-year-out membership expansion and Dv <= 0.15 orbit gate. Global hierarchy-core anchors retain their normal core-only output semantics.
metrics: final overlap, precision, recall, F1 against the 95-event canonical sample
evaluation.baseline_reproduction_rule: The selected 8/4 and [3.5,3.0,2.5,2.5] cell must reproduce the frozen rank-7, 123-member, 95/95 result before any sensitivity result is accepted.

stopping_and_interpretation_rule: Run the entire frozen grid. Do not add, remove, narrow, retune, or substitute settings after observing results. A sensitive result is reported as sensitivity; it is not repaired by choosing a better-performing cell.
